The '''Vorsia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Vorsian crystal]].<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Vorsian crystal]]|system=Vorsia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vorsia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
